## 2024-05-23 - Bulk Database Operations in AI Generation Pipelines
**Learning:** Using sequential `.create()` inside large `for` loops for generated AI content (like quiz questions or study plan tasks) can severely bottleneck performance due to Postgres N+1 queries.
**Action:** Always prefer Prisma's `createMany` for bulk insertions when persisting multiple records generated by AI pipelines at once, mapping data into an array beforehand.
